title: The Future of AI Agents
content: AI agents are transitioning from simple chatbots to autonomous systems that can reason, plan, and use tools. The key to this evolution is the integration of long-term memory and the ability to interact with external APIs. We are seeing a shift from 'chat-first' to 'action-first' interfaces.

title: Why Fast-API is the Best for AI
content: FastAPI's asynchronous nature makes it perfect for handling long-running LLM requests. By using background tasks, developers can provide a snappy user experience while the AI processes data in the background. Its native Pydantic support also ensures data integrity.
